sources: Blessing of Lustrous Carmine (6-star polearm; Camille wears it in both her logs). Skill 3 sk_wpn_lance_0015 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; SkillPatchTable L1–L9 ultimate_gain_up 0.18–0.504, atk_up and fire_dmg_up 0.06–0.168, duration and duration2 20 s): cardAttributeModifier attribute 44 (Ultimate Gain Efficiency) +ultimate_gain_up is a stat-panel line, as are skills 1–2 (Agility, Heat DMG).

abilityEvent 142 (OnObtainAtb) + CheckObtainAtbType atbGainMethod [0] atbSourceType [3] (the wielder's skill recovers natural SP) → buff_wpn_lance_0015_atkup on the team (CharacterTeamFinder): ATK (attribute 2 formulaItem 6) +atk_up for duration. Logged on the SP-granting hit itself (Camille's combo hit 3: 40d9 9240, 4e5e 7982 / 30769 ms), so SP granted before a hit's damage (KitHit.spBeforeDamage) shows it on that hit.

abilityEvent 126 (OnCharBeforeOutputSpellInfliction) + CheckOriginSkillType [2, 6, 7] (battle, combo, ultimate) + CheckSpellInflictionType mask 1 (Heat) → buff_wpn_lance_0015_dmgup on the team: Heat DMG (attribute 51 formulaItem 5) +fire_dmg_up (assigned to the buff's dmg_up) for duration2. Logged on the inflicting battle-skill hit itself (beforeDamage; test 51's question answered for this handler). An infliction that forms a reaction counts: the kit counts it since 2026-10-22 (`reactions: true`, the owner's reading; abilityEvent 126 fires before the game resolves the infliction; in-game test 35 can still confirm).

Both buffs stackingType 4 with priority key pd_up and maxStackCntKey max_stack (keys the weapon doesn't have): one instance, a reapplication refreshes. Its toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up from the weapon's blackboard) is a template leftover with no effect, as Twilight's.
